title: EventEnvelope
description: Standardized, immutable envelope wrapping all system events.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific event.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier tracking the causal chain.

timestamp_exchange.description: Timestamp reported by the external exchange or venue (or local if generated internally).

timestamp_local.description: Timestamp recorded locally by the node at arrival/generation.

source.description: Origin of the event (e.g. CTRADER, BINANCE_SPOT, LOCAL_NODE, PWA).

device_id.description: Unique identifier of the publishing device.

event_type.description: Discriminator enum for the enclosed payload.

payload.description: Event payload adhering to the corresponding event schema.
